title: Cybersecurity & Pen-Test Matrix
rules: Treat every external input as hostile: validate, normalize, then trust.
Server-side authorization on every request; client checks are UX only.
Row Level Security must be enabled and tested per table policy.
Secrets live in a vault or environment; rotate on exposure immediately.
Escape at render boundaries; parameterize at query boundaries.
Log security-relevant events with actor, action, resource and outcome.
Rate-limit authentication and expensive endpoints by identity, not just IP.
redFlags: RLS disabled on user data table
checklist: OWASP Top 10 walkthrough documented for the current release?
Are dependencies pinned and scanned (npm audit / osv)?
Is there an incident runbook with contact path and rollback?
Are backups encrypted and tested by restore?
Is least-privilege enforced for service accounts?

scoringRubric.1-3: Critical exposure: injection possible, secrets in repo, no RLS.
scoringRubric.4-6: Basic hygiene: some validation, incomplete authorization review.
scoringRubric.7-8: Hardened: parameterized queries, RLS tested, secrets managed, rate limits.
scoringRubric.9-10: Adversarial-ready: continuous scanning, red-team drills, least privilege everywhere.
